entries.content: [ Runeterra: is the name of the physical world rich with diverse races and habitats, many of which are far older than the mortals who now inhabit them. The world is divided into distinct regions, each with its own unique culture and conflicts. Notable regions include: Demacia(kingdom known for justice and a suspicion of magic), Noxus(brutal empire built on strength and ambition), Ionia(land of peace and spirituality), Piltover and Zaun(duo of cities representing progress and chaotic invention), The Freljord(icy tundra where powerful tribes battle for dominance), Shurima(ancient desert empire that is now reawakening), The Shadow Isles(cursed realm of spectral horror); ]

entries.content: [ Ionia: is a vast archipelago known to many as the "First Lands". Its geography is a blend of rugged mountains, tranquil rivers, and ancient forests. The culture of the Ionian people has long been shaped by a pursuit of balance between the physical and spiritual worlds, and the border between these two realms is notably permeable here, particularly in the untamed wilderness. This strong connection to the spirit realm has led to a land where magic suffuses every part of life; ]

entries.content: [ Dreaming Tree: is a magical tree that grows in a hidden garden within an Ionian forest. It is a descendant of the ancient God-Willow, also known as Omikayalan. The tree serves as a repository for humanity's dreams, gathering them in its blooms. The Dreaming Tree's health is directly tied to the dreams it collects; ]

entries.content: [ Spirit Realm: is a singular dimension that exists in parallel to the physical world of Runeterra. The boundary between the two is particularly thin in Ionia, allowing magic and supernatural entities to easily pass through. It is a place of raw, chaotic magical energy where emotions and mental concepts are given tangible form. The Spirit Realm is home to various spiritual beings, including spirits, demons, and the elusive yordles; ]

entries.content: [ Garden of Forgetting: is a specific, sacred grove within Ionia, described as a labyrinthine caldera filled with wild trees and lush, blooming flowers. According to legend, a powerful spirit was moved by a woman's grief and turned her tears to flowers, giving birth to the garden. The purpose of the Garden of Forgetting is to help those with weary hearts ease their pain by giving up their sorrowful memories; ]

entries.content: [ Fae Fawn: is a type of fae creature. In Ionian lore, fae are magically-infused beings who are as unpredictable as the enchanted environment they inhabit. They are often cunning and are known for weaving their words to be deceitful without speaking an outright lie; ]

entries.content: [ Ivern: is a peculiar half-man, half-tree creature who cultivates life across Runeterra's forests. He was once a ferocious warrior named Ivern the Cruel, but he was transformed when he foolishly cut down the God-Willow(Omikayalan), which is the ancestor of Dreaming Tree. The dying magic of the God-Willow infused Ivern, turning him into a benevolent being and connecting him to the natural world; ]

entries.content: [ Valoran: is the northern continent of Runeterra. Valoran is connected to the now Shuriman Continent through a small artificial land bridge; ]

entries.content: [ Shuriman Continent: is the southern continent of Runeterra. The most predominant nation on this continent is Shurima from which it gained its name. This continent is now connected to Valoran through a small artificial land bridge; ]

entries.content: [ Vastaya: are a chimeric race of Runeterra that are the weaker magical descendants from enlightened mortals that took the power of the spirit realm into themselves known as the Vastayashai'rei. Vastaya can look considerably different from one another, but they all share animal and human characteristics; ]
